reserves.name: U.S. Treasury bills & cash (M0 eligible collateral)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: M0 permissioned minters and eligible collateral SPVs

reserveReview.rationale: MetaMask states that mUSD is backed by short-term Treasury collateral. M0 now exposes only the on-chain-indexed Minter Gateway total: its off-chain CollateralCurrent composition feed was retired in August 2026, as recorded in the adapter comment in worker/src/cron/reserve-adapters/m0.ts. The reviewed composition therefore contains one 100% keyed aggregate classified as other because no current cash/Treasury split is published; the former 97.9% tokenized-Treasury / 2.1% cash snapshot is not treated as live. Minter-specific provider allocations and account-level custody terms remain undisclosed by Bridge/M0 and remain separate custody uncertainty.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current first-party M0 Protocol API on-chain-indexed Minter Gateway total for the collateral pool backing $M and its extensions
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current M0 source exposes the full aggregate total but not its internal cash/Treasury allocation, minter-level provider shares, or mUSD-specific custody terms; the retired 97.9/2.1 composition is not current.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Bridge and M0 document segregated or bankruptcy-remote collateral architecture and name generic reserve partners, but do not publish mUSD-specific provider allocations, account-level terms, or rehypothecation restrictions.
